scorecard.title: College Scorecard (location, enrollment, cost; data released 2026-10-15)

cds.title: Grinnell College Common Data Set 2024-2025 (PDF, Institutional Research; the newest one posted)

cost.notes: First-year, full-time costs for the full 2025-26 year from the Common Data Set (G1, G5): tuition $71,788, required fees $558, on-campus housing $8,112 + food $9,236 = $17,348. Estimated expenses: books and supplies $800, other expenses $1,850 (no transportation figure reported). Grinnell's cost-of-attendance page lists 2026-27 (on-campus basic room): tuition $73,582, activity fee $572, housing $8,316, food $9,468, miscellaneous personal $1,100, transportation $300+, total $93,338+ (required books and course materials are included in tuition). The Common Data Set leaves the nonresident aid counts (H6) blank; institutional need-based aid is available

stats.notes: Fall 2024 entering class (Common Data Set 2024-2025; Grinnell has not posted a 2025-2026 CDS). Totals: 9,758 applied (5,048 men, 4,421 women, 289 another gender), 1,416 admitted (637 / 725 / 54), 438 enrolled (211 / 211 / 16). Grinnell left the C1 residency breakdown (in-state, out-of-state, international applicants and admits) blank, so those fields are empty; 98 of the 438 enrolled first-years are nonresidents (B2). Early Decision (binding; first and second round together): 828 applied, 283 admitted. Grinnell reported no high-school GPA data (C11/C12 blank). Undergraduate enrollment (1,788) and the nonresident count (365) are the CDS 'Total Undergraduates' figures. SAT/ACT submission is optional: 29% of enrolled first-years (129) submitted SAT and 21% (92) ACT.
